sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027

growing.note: Q3 FY2027 revenue was $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year.

moat.note: The company reported continued demand for its accelerated-computing platforms and shipment of Vera Rubin NVL72.

management.note: The board announced Jensen Huang's immediate resignation and appointed Colette Kress as interim CEO and CFO.

margins.note: GAAP gross margin was 74.8% in Q3 FY2027, versus 73.4% a year earlier.

cash.note: NVIDIA reported $28.1 billion returned to shareholders during Q3 FY2027 and $227.3 billion remaining under its repurchase authorization.

risk.note: The disclosure identifies leadership transition, regulatory inquiries, supply-demand uncertainty, and the absence of China compute revenue in Q4 guidance.
risk.reporting_period: Q3 fiscal 2027 and November 12, 2026 leadership announcement

growing.note: Consolidated Q3 2026 revenue was $127.6 billion, up 25% year over year.

moat.note: The disclosure describes Search, Ads, Chrome, Cloud, YouTube, and Android as major products used globally, but competitive durability is not fully quantified.

management.note: Management reported increased investment in AI talent, Gemini, and technical infrastructure; capital-allocation effectiveness was not fully established.

margins.note: Q3 2026 cost of revenue rose 24% and operating expenses rose 20%, while the reviewed release confirms strong quarterly results.

cash.note: Operating cash flow was $42.3 billion in Q3 2026 and $179.6 billion for the trailing twelve months.
cash.reporting_period: Q3 2026 and trailing twelve months ended September 30, 2026

risk.note: The reviewed disclosure indicates materially higher AI infrastructure, depreciation, talent, and operating-investment costs; full downside risk evidence is incomplete.
